details:
What does it do & how does it work? Our project, "Lost Tools, Found Dreams," is an interactive, illustrated sci-fi graphic novel designed for youth and teenagers. It follows the journey of characters Sham, Nour, and Amal as they encounter historic and discarded NASA equipment left in space (such as the ISS Tool Bag, ALSEP components, and the Opportunity Rover). The project bridges authentic space data with an engaging narrative to prove that these relics are "Abandoned, but not forgotten."

Benefits and Intended Impact: The project raises awareness about space debris and historical mission hardware while inspiring young readers with core moral values—such as resilience, embracing failure as a stepping stone, patience, and turning dreams into reality through perseverance.

Tools and Technologies Used:

  • Initial Script & Story Writing: Microsoft Word for drafting and organizing the preliminary script and storyline.
  • Content & Narrative Design: Custom writing workflows and story structures.
  • Presentation & Visual Layout: Google Slides for creating the structured presentation.
  • Assisted Tools: AI tools were thoughtfully utilized to refine grammar, spelling, and enhance the creative presentation layout.
